source_findings.finding: on_frame stores a callback without module ownership. A plugin image callback may register one and then return failure; plugins_image dlcloses the module and erases its Plugin record without visibly removing that callback. A native port needs owner-scoped registration and retirement or resident disabled modules before exposing this lifecycle.

Core::InstallConditionalGuestCodeHook now branches on the current callback result before restoring guest state. True returns snapshot RAX; false executes the original instructions with rewritten arguments. Both paths restore GPR/YMM/MXCSR/flags. No shared skip flag. Eight simultaneous threads (16,000 calls), recursive opposite decisions, callable original, argument/return changes and carry preservation pass. The BBHOST plugin adapter and owner lifecycle remain pending.
source_findings.installation_contract: Install before any thread can execute the patched site; serialized registration alone is not a live-patching protocol.

native_callback_retirement.allocation_policy: Copy-on-write registration and retirement; dispatch takes a shared snapshot without allocating. No task installed in a normal run without a host.
native_callback_retirement.ownership: The host supplies a shared pin owning its dlopen reference. Owners, entries and dispatch snapshots retain it. Other HLE/hook/thread callbacks need their own residency before global module unloading can be claimed.
native_callback_retirement.retirement: Close admission first, remove published entries, then drain running callbacks outside all registry dispatch callbacks. Inside callbacks return false without waiting, including cross-registry retirement. Snapshots retain executable residency through callback return.
native_callback_retirement.exceptions: Catch at callback boundary, disable owner, report failure count. Host must later Retire to remove entries and release pins.
native_callback_retirement.verified_scope: Real DSO ordinary retirement and self-retirement, stale snapshots, concurrency, dedup, capacity reuse, quarantine; original retail pacer entry/trampoline with substituted later body. Full live plugin host not implemented.

native_owner_disable_actions.behavior: Exactly one action when owner admission closes, for explicit retirement or frame/hook quarantine. No registry locks held during action. Retire outside callbacks/actions waits for active callbacks and action completion; retirement inside either never waits.
native_owner_disable_actions.action_lifetime: Shared context owns copied backend function and owner ID; no Module pointer captured. Notification must be noexcept and must not free userdata still used by active callbacks.
native_owner_disable_actions.hle: Module attaches native HLE retirement to owner action; explicit Close no longer maintains a separate cleanup path. Cached imports restore native fallback before synchronous quarantine action completes.
